_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.

items.text: NEW: pick your college on the TMC Builder tab — every TMC now shows whether you already have that ADT approved (✓ Approved / ⏳ In progress / ◐ Teach-out, with the control number + approval date), and opening one shows a banner up top. With 'All colleges' selected, each TMC shows how many CA colleges already have it. It's straight from the COCI program export you sent. Spot-check a few of your college's against what you know — flag anything that looks wrong (it dedupes old→new, so a replaced degree shows the new one).

The C-ID discrepancies (rows whose C-ID isn't in our reference) now show a ⚠ flag inline. Still on offer: an exportable report of those discrepancies you could hand to the C-ID team. Say the word and Fable builds it.

Confirm the obvious families; UNCHECK or Skip a genuine progression (units are the tell). Still queued: the 🏷 title-similarity lane (~5,457 groups). Say the word and Fable DRY-RUNs a high-cosine, cross-college, band-gated pass 2 (reversible, marker automerge-titlelane-v1) for your review before anything applies.
